# Google Code to Learn

<p class="sx-lede">My first app: a Sudoku app for Android, built in Class 5.</p>

The app imports, shares and solves Sudoku puzzles of different grid sizes. I entered it in the Google India Code to Learn Contest 2019, a national contest for school students, and it was selected as a winner of the Class 5 & 6 category.
